completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 2 条。

text.en:
Revised Edition of the Laws Act
(Chapter 275, Section 11(3))
Order under Section 11(3)
O 24
G.N. No. S 350/2000
REVISED EDITION 2002
(31st January 2002)
[31st July 2001]
Whereas pursuant to section 10 of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act, the Law Revision Commissioners have published in loose-leaf form the Acts set out in the Schedule as in force on 30th June 2001:
And Whereas it is provided under section 11(3) of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act that the Commissioners shall transmit to the President a copy of each of the loose-leaf edition of these Acts and the President may thereupon, by order published in the Gazette, specify that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, in all courts and for all purposes, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts:
Now therefore it is hereby ordered by the President that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, with effect from 31st July 2001, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts.

THE SCHEDULE
1. Business Registration Act (Chapter 32)
2. Cinematograph Film Hire Duty Act (Chapter 40)
3. Civil Defence Act (Chapter 42)
4. Control of Manufacture Act (Chapter 57)
5. Customs Act (Chapter 70)
6. Departmental Titles (Alteration) Act (Chapter 77)
7. Economic Development Board Act (Chapter 85)
8. Economic Expansion Incentives (Relief from Income Tax) Act (Chapter 86)
9. Estate Duty Act (Chapter 96)
10. Goods and Services Tax Act (Chapter 117A)
11. High Court (Admiralty Jurisdiction) Act (Chapter 123)
12. Intoxicating Substances Act (Chapter 146A)
13. Maintenance of Religious Harmony Act (Chapter 167A)
14. Misuse of Drugs Act (Chapter 185)
15. National Council of Social Service Act (Chapter 195A)
16. Parliamentary Elections Act (Chapter 218)
17. Public Entertainments and Meetings Act (Chapter 257)
18. Reciprocal Enforcement of Foreign Judgements Act (Chapter 265)
19. Trade Development Board Act (Chapter 330).
[G.N. No. S 350/2001]
